title: E(n)-Equivariant Spherical Decision Surfaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.32815v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a constructive derivation of exactly E(n)-equivariant spherical decision surfaces by extending prior O(n)-equivariant hypersphere neurons to include translations. To achieve this, we present a decomposition of the features of the O(n)-equivariant neurons and provide explicit representations for translation and E(n)-transformations to fulfil the respective equivariance constraints. The resulting decision surfaces are exactly E(n)-equivariant without input centring or explicit pairwise differences, and admit explicit closed-form matrix representations. In addition, we numerically verify the correctness of the derivations and perform a downstream check of the resulting geometric primitives.

translated_abstract: 我们通过将先前的O(n)等变超球面神经元扩展以包含平移，提出了严格E(n)等变球面决策曲面的构造性推导。为实现这一目标，我们对O(n)等变神经元的特征进行了分解，并为平移和E(n)变换提供了显式表示，以满足相应的等变性约束。所得的决策曲面在无需输入中心化或显式成对差值的情况下即严格E(n)等变，并且具有显式的闭式矩阵表示。此外，我们通过数值方法验证了推导的正确性，并对所得的几何基元进行了下游检验。
tldr: 该论文通过将O(n)等变超球面神经元扩展以包含平移，构造性地推导出无需输入中心化或显式成对差值即严格E(n)等变的球面决策曲面，并给出其显式闭式矩阵表示。
